causal_claim.content: When wavelength mismatch vanishes, coupling efficiency becomes maximal.

evidence_spans: The device can generate both continuous-wave and self-induced pulsed laser outputs.
When the pump power was increased to the milliwatt level, self-induced pulsed laser emission began to emerge.
Driven by this nonlinear thermo-optic–photorefractive dynamics, we observed this self-induced pulsed laser in the Nd:LNOI microdisk with a pulse duration on the order of hundreds of microseconds.

evidence_result.content: In the self-induced pulsed regime, pump transmission and pulsed laser output are temporally synchronized; adjacent pulses are separated by 6.45 ms; the minimum pump-transmission dip width is 12.6 µs (duty ratio 1.95 × 10−3); and the emitted laser pulses have a broadened linewidth of about 500 µs with duty ratio 7.75 × 10−2, more than an order-of-magnitude improvement over earlier results.
evidence_spans: The two waveforms exhibit clear temporal synchronization
The temporal separation between two adjacent pulses is measured to be 6.45 ms.
The minimum dip width of the pump transmission reaches 12.6 µs, corresponding to a duty ratio of 1.95 × 10−3.
The emitted laser pulses exhibit a broadened linewidth of approximately 500 µs, with a duty ratio of only 7.75 × 10−2
which represents more than one order-of-magnitude improvement compared to our earlier results[28]

evidence_result.content: With increasing pump power beyond the onset range of pulsing, the pulse frequency and duty ratio become largely insensitive to further power increases.
evidence_spans: Beyond this range, both the pulse frequency and duty ratio become largely insensitive to further increases in pump power.

evidence_result.content: As the pump wavelength increases, the pulse frequency and duty ratio first decrease and then increase.
evidence_spans: we observe that both the frequency and duty ratio of the pulsed laser show a trend of ﬁrst decreasing and then increasing as the pump wavelength increases.

evidence_result.content: As context for the platform, LNOI thin films now exhibit propagation losses below 0.1 dB/cm together with strong optical confinement.
evidence_spans: Single-crystalline thin ﬁlms with submicrometer thicknesses now exhibit propagation losses below 0.1 dB/cm and strong optical conﬁnement[18].

constraint.content: LNOI has a thermal stability limit below the temperatures required for diffusion doping.
evidence_spans: requires temperatures exceeding 1000 °C—far beyond the thermal stability limit of LNOI
